name: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
note: The THEATRE, checked before use: it shares an edge with way/24563073 (the galleries), carries the same wikidata=Q1884883 with amenity=arts_centre and height=36 (a fly tower), its far end is 31 m off Howard Street and its long side 2 m off the Esplanade footway. Modelled 2026-09-23 from the owner's own STREET photograph and a second from inside the pedestrian passage on the east side: three masses along the frontage — a glazed lobby cube with a bright red entrance canopy, a near-black matt-panelled mass, a small pale block and the tall pale FLY TOWER — over broad shallow steps, with the walkway up to garden level at the left. The east wall is sheer panelled grid on a dark base course, full height to the passage floor. The plan is cut at its two narrowest stations; the fly tower is the larger end band and the lobby the smaller, which puts the lobby at the Howard Street end. NO RAKE: the owner first described 'one side sloped steeply down' but neither photograph shows a slope, so it is not modelled — see the builder's comment. GROUND FLOOR IS LEVEL 2 (docs/YERBA-BUENA.md), so features start at the gardens builder's exported DECK_H and the steps climb to it. See src/render/landmarks/sf/ybca.ts; renders in docs/shots/models/ybca-theatre-street and -east.
